name: turn-gauge
description: Band above the prompt: turn number, output speed, turn and session cost, prompt cache countdown, model, effort, context fill, cache hit rate and token counts, plan-limit pace projection; warns on running out before a reset, cache misses and output-heavy turns; notifies before the cache expires.

keepTurns.title: Turns kept when compacting
keepTurns.description: How many recent turns the band's compact button and `/turn-gauge compact` keep word for word. Claude Code's own /compact and auto-compaction are not affected.

background.title: Band background
background.description: A color behind the band, to set it apart from the terminal: hex (#1e2430), a color name (blue), a theme key (subtle) or userMessageBackground. Empty keeps the terminal's background.

terminalIcons.title: Terminal icons
terminalIcons.description: How the band's icons draw in the terminal: emoji (⚡ 💰 ⏳), or glyphs (⚡ $ ⧗) colored like the band. The desktop app draws its own icons either way.
